source_document.body:
On today’s numerically-infused episode of Quick Charge , we take a look at all the latest product and delivery delays from Tesla’s Q3 earnings call before changing lanes and recapping some of the biggest developments in the world of EV charging innovation.
You read that right: after years of broken promises and delays unsupervised Full Self Driving remains at least six months away for what certainly feels like the ninth year in a row, while the humanoid Optimus robot does its best Ricky Bobby impression and Porsche, BMW, and Liebherr show up with some genuine innovations to speed up EV charging and eliminate range anxiety once and for all.

Tesla (TSLA) quietly cuts 2026 capex guidance to $20B
Tesla pushes Optimus deliveries to late 2027, says hands still a problem
It’s finally here: Porsche puts wireless charging into production [UPDATE]
BMW iX5 hits up to 460 kW during first public fast-charging demo
Fortescue is using KUKA welding robots to handle 6 MW charging cables
